verdict.rationale: The Division documents a fax and mail rail for name reservations. Its fillable PDF entity forms can also be submitted by mail, so formation tasks have a non-online fallback. However, the evidence never gives the exact mailing address or fax number. The annual report and franchise tax filing is documented as 'required to be filed online', so that task has no fallback. Missing for 10: exact published mailing addresses and fax numbers, a named form list tied to the mail/fax rail, a fallback for the mandatory-online annual report and franchise tax filing, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: You may also submit your reservation application in writing. You may upload, fax or mail in your request to our office.
The entity forms are PDF fillable and can be submitted using our Document Filing and Certificate Request Service or by mail.
